judged_text: Webhook's findFirst has no orderBy, so it nondeterministically picks an arbitrary credential when duplicates exist

record.issue_text: Webhook's findFirst has no orderBy, so it nondeterministically picks an arbitrary credential when duplicates exist

adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the code looks up an existing credential via `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })` without an `orderBy`. If the database contains multiple credentials matching that `(userId, appId)` pair, Prisma will return an arbitrary match, so the subsequent `update` may target a nondeterministic record.
